import json, sys, random, urllib.request

data = json.load(sys.stdin)
ctx = data["context"]

req = urllib.request.Request(f"http://localhost:4000/api/workflows/{ctx['workflowId']}")
with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
    wf = json.loads(resp.read())

defn = wf["definition"]
if isinstance(defn, str):
    defn = json.loads(defn)

agents = [n for n in defn["nodes"] if n["type"] == "agent"]
agents.sort(key=lambda n: n["id"])

roles = ["godfather", "mafia", "mafia", "detective", "doctor",
         "townsperson", "townsperson", "townsperson", "townsperson"]
random.shuffle(roles)

factions = {"godfather": "mafia", "mafia": "mafia",
            "detective": "town", "doctor": "town", "townsperson": "town"}

players = []
for i, agent in enumerate(agents):
    players.append({
        "id": i + 1,
        "nodeId": agent["id"],
        "name": agent["data"]["label"],
        "role": roles[i],
        "faction": factions[roles[i]],
        "alive": True,
        "eliminated_day": None
    })

state = {
    "players": players,
    "day": 1,
    "phase": "day_chat",
    "chat_log": [],
    "votes": [],
    "night_log": [],
    "eliminations": [],
    "winner": None,
    "last_protected": None,
    "context": ctx
}

print(json.dumps(state))
